# Quaternius Platformer Game Kit

- Creator: Quaternius
- Official pack page: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateplatformer.html
- Official download folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NDZn_aGnn0vfFV3M22Y8GPcDjO8BVcLs
- Retrieved: 2026-08-24
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal

Only selected visual FBX files were imported. No character, enemy, gameplay code,
Unity project, package settings, or custom shader from the source pack is used.

Imported files:

- Cloud_1.fbx
- Cloud_2.fbx
- Cube_Grass_Center.fbx
- Cube_Grass_Corner.fbx
- Rock_1.fbx
- Rock_2.fbx
- RockPlatform_Tall.fbx
- RockPlatforms_Large.fbx
- RockPlatforms_Medium.fbx
- Tree.fbx

The meshes are visual-only in BattleScene. Existing project-owned colliders and
combat scripts remain responsible for gameplay.
